verdict.rationale: Lithic is API-first. It has a documented public REST API with an endpoint reference (e.g., POST /cards), dated API versioning via the api-version header, and an Events API for managing webhooks. It also offers sandbox simulation endpoints, an llms.txt describing a programmatic interface, and an MCP server that executes live API calls. Missing for 10: a publicly discoverable OpenAPI spec (the probed paths returned 404) and independent hands-on corroboration of API usage.
